business_summary: KG Intelligence CO., LTD. operates as a content provider company. The company offers Wagasha de DOMO! x Alpa Connect, a tool that manage and operate all postings on eAlpa and other aggregate sites all at once; ARPA LINK, a spot work matching app to pinpoint job openings based on time, location, and skills; e-Arra, a recruitment site that provides information on part-time, full-time, and temporary employment; ALPA, a free job information magazine; and ARPA presents the Suitable Job Fair, an introduction site for the suitable job fair. It also provides career counseling, employment support, and job change support services, as well as foreign care human resource development program; Home Building School, a free consultation support service for home building; Rental Style, a website that provides information on rental apartments, condominiums, and detached houses; Rental Style Column; Mom Rental, a website to search for rental properties near elementary and junior high school districts; Kodate Rental, a website that collects and publishes detached houses and rental homes; Kodate Rental Column; Hospita Renta, a website to search for rental properties near hospitals and medical institutions; Hospita Rental Column; Gakuheya Rental; Gakuhair Rental Column; Chukodate!, a website to search for information on purchasing vacant houses, used homes, detached houses, and single-family; Chukoma!; Kaitochi!; IETO; Mom's House Building; Sumai Satei, a real estate sales website for women; and Rental Style Moving Estimates. In addition, the company offers information magazines; Mama Sore, a website that provides news and columns for mothers raising children; human resource development support, competitor store research, human resource recruitment support, and website creation support services; and printing and binding services, including posters, flyers, pamphlets, and free papers. KG Intelligence CO., LTD. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: KG인텔리전스(주) 콘텐츠 제공업체로 운영됩니다. 회사는 Wagasha de DOMO를 제공합니다! x eAlpa 및 기타 집계 사이트의 모든 게시물을 한 번에 관리하고 운영하는 도구인 Alpa Connect; 시간, 위치 및 기술을 기반으로 채용 공고를 정확히 찾아내는 현장 일자리 매칭 앱인 ARPA LINK 파트타임, 정규직, 임시직 채용정보를 제공하는 채용사이트 e-Arra 무료 직업정보지 ALPA; ARPA는 적합한 채용박람회 소개 사이트인 적합한 채용박람회를 선보입니다. 또한 진로상담, 취업지원, 전직지원 서비스와 외국인 돌봄 인력양성 프로그램도 제공하고 있다. 주택 건설을 위한 무료 상담 지원 서비스인 주택 건설 학교(Home Building School); 임대아파트, 콘도, 단독주택 정보를 제공하는 홈페이지 렌탈스타일, 렌탈 스타일 칼럼; 초·중학교 인근 임대주택을 검색하는 사이트 맘렌탈, 단독 주택 및 임대 주택을 수집하고 게시하는 웹 사이트 Kodate Rental; 코다테 렌탈 칼럼; 병원, 의료기관 인근 임대 매물을 검색하는 사이트 호스피타 렌타(Hospita Renta)
